integrity: An exact unrestricted proof in the stated five-run domain, complemented by finite independently implemented checks; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to nonempty contiguous palindromic factors of exactly five maximal runs, not scattered subsequences.
Does not claim a new qualitative criterion for arbitrary rich binary words; earlier run-length criteria may subsume qualitative richness cases.
An equivalent five-run quantitative defect enumerator could exist in unindexed or otherwise unavailable literature.
title: Exact palindromic-defect distribution of five-run binary words
